description: Onboarding processes, product listing guidelines, inventory management, and seller dashboard documentation.
overview: MilletVerse provides dedicated onboarding for artisanal food makers, cottage home bakers, micro-enterprises, and established health food brands specializing in millet biscuits, snacks, and baked goods.

seller_registration_steps.name: Account Creation
seller_registration_steps.details: Navigate to the Register page on MilletVerse, choose 'Seller' as the user role, and provide your business name, official email, phone number, and physical commercial/kitchen address.

seller_registration_steps.name: Documentation & Compliance
seller_registration_steps.details: Upload mandatory regulatory documents: FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India) registration or home-baker license, GSTIN (if turnover requires), and bank account details for sales settlements.

seller_registration_steps.name: Admin Approval
seller_registration_steps.details: MilletVerse administrators verify food safety compliance and recipe purity. Once approved (status 'is_approved' = true), the seller dashboard is instantly unlocked.

mandatory_product_fields: Product Name: Descriptive title (e.g., 'Ragi Chocolate Chip Biscuits')
Description: Product story, texture, taste, and crafting method
Complete Ingredient List: Full transparency with all ingredients (flours, sweeteners, fats, spices)
Nutritional Facts Panel: Per 100g metrics for energy (calories), protein, carbohydrates, dietary fiber, fats, and standout micronutrients (calcium/iron)
Price (INR): Retail selling price inclusive of applicable taxes
Inventory / Stock Quantity: Initial packaged stock ready for dispatch
Product Image URL: High-resolution clear photograph of the product and packaging
product_listing_guidelines.purity_standards: All products must adhere to MilletVerse's clean-label policy: zero maida, no hydrogenated trans-fats, and no artificial chemical preservatives.

seller_dashboard_features.description: Add new products, edit pricing, update stock counts, toggle product availability (active/inactive), and manage product descriptions.
View incoming customer orders, change order status ('processing', 'shipped'), print packing slips, and enter courier tracking numbers.
Monitor genuine buyer ratings and feedback to refine product quality and recipes.
Track total orders, top-selling items, revenue analytics, and scheduled payout settlement dates.
